svg.text: UX Designer at Peak Consulting Inc.

text.tspan: Weekend parenting energy is a different sport
than weekday parenting.
We practiced apologizing after I snapped about
shoes by the door.
What would you have done?
Being present is harder than being productive.
Dinner was simple and the conversation was
better for it.
Children need witnesses more than they need
performance.
We are negotiating screen time like it is a
union contract.
Protect one unhurried stretch of the evening.
They wanted to show me a drawing mid-email.
The drawing won.
Ask what help looks like before you offer
solutions.
I put my phone in another room for the first
hour after pickup.
Kids notice what we prioritize, not what we
post.
Car rides are when the real questions arrive.
Your calm is a co-regulation tool, not a
personality trait you either have.
I caught myself using my work voice at home
and had to reset.
I am learning to apologize to a seven-year-old
without making it a speech.
We are negotiating screen time like it is a
union contract.
Routines reduce friction more than pep talks
do.
Dinner was simple and the conversation was
better for it.
Your calm is a co-regulation tool, not a
personality trait you either have.
We practiced apologizing after I snapped about
shoes by the door.
